**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fix attestation that incorrectly claims no .claude edits**

This attestation is internally inconsistent with the same commit: `b30a29f0` adds/edits files under `.claude/` (`.claude/claude.md` and `.claude/modules/shared/governance-principles.md`), so asserting no `.claude/` edits makes the proof artifact inaccurate and can mislead any downstream audit/automation that relies on these attestations as factual evidence.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Correct companion doc path to the actual tracked filename**

The new governance text points to `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, but this repository tracks `.claude/claude.md` (lowercase). On case-sensitive filesystems this breaks the documented cross-reference and the “keep these three files in sync” instruction, which can cause future updates to target a non-existent file.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
